name: pipane
description: A clean web interface for the pi coding agent — chat UI with real-time tool calls, streaming output, session management, and model picker
author: Mike Heunher

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && concurrently --raw --kill-others-on-fail "vite build" "tsc -p tsconfig.server.json" && node scripts/write-build-info.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e:stress: npm run build && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test -c playwright.config.ts e2e/real-stack.e2e.ts e2e/rerun-duplicate.e2e.ts --timeout 60000 --repeat-each 50 --workers 2
scripts.test:all: concurrently --raw --kill-others-on-fail "nice -n 10 npm run check" "nice -n 10 npm run test:coverage" "npm run test:e2e"
scripts.test:screenshots: npm run build && PIPANE_CAPTURE_LATEST_SCREENSHOTS=1 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test -c playwright.config.ts e2e/ui-screenshots.e2e.ts
scripts.test:screenshots:update: npm run build && PIPANE_CAPTURE_LATEST_SCREENSHOTS=1 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test -c playwright.config.ts e2e/ui-screenshots.e2e.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:walkthrough: npm run build && RUN_WALKTHROUGH=1 node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test -c playwright.walkthrough.config.ts --timeout 180000
